not_yet_due.criterion: Actual workforce shares for Bally’s Bronx permanent operations: 70% Bronx residents, 47% women, and 75% minorities.
not_yet_due.quote: Bally’s project, Bally’s Bronx, is a proposed single-phase, integrated casino resort located at Bally’s Golf Links at Ferry Point in the Bronx, New York. The project represents a total capital investment of $2.3 billion and is projected to open by mid- 2030.

criteria.criterion: Bally’s said 70% of employees for Bally’s Bronx permanent operations would be Bronx residents.
criteria.promise_scope: Promisor: Bally’s (as applicant). Intended beneficiaries/covered group: the permanent-operation workforce of the proposed Bally’s Bronx project, specifically employees who would be hired for that project. Location: the Bronx, New York. Benefit/action: Bally’s states that 70% of employees/workers will be Bronx residents.
criteria.observed_scope: Observed evidence only documents the proposal for the planned Bronx project and repeats the target of Bronx-based employees. No evidence shows an actual hired Bally’s Bronx permanent workforce yet, and no actual share of Bronx-resident employees is reported.
criteria.timing_requirement: For permanent operations of Bally’s Bronx; the project is "projected to open by mid- 2030," and another excerpt says Bally’s "will not be operational in the first three and one-half years of the projection period."
criteria.explanation: The cited materials clearly document the promise/target: Bally’s states that 70% of the permanent-operation workforce will come from the Bronx. But the same source set also says the project is still proposed, not yet operational, and projected to open by mid-2030. As of 2026-11-22, there is no due workforce outcome to verify for an operating Bronx casino workforce.
criteria.gap: No direct evidence yet shows actual Bally’s Bronx permanent-operation hiring or the realized share of employees who are Bronx residents.

criteria.criterion: Bally’s said 47% of employees for Bally’s Bronx would be women.
criteria.promise_scope: Promisor: Bally’s (as applicant), as quoted in the selection document. Intended beneficiaries/covered group: employees of the proposed Bally’s Bronx project. Location: the Bronx, New York. Benefit/action: Bally’s states that 47% of employees will be women.
criteria.observed_scope: Observed evidence documents the stated target for the proposed Bronx project and cites Chicago as background. The only actual workforce figure in the excerpts is for Bally’s Chicago temporary facility, where 45% are women; that is a different site and population. No evidence shows an actual Bally’s Bronx workforce or actual women share there.
criteria.timing_requirement: For the workforce of the proposed Bally’s Bronx project; the project is "projected to open by mid- 2030."
criteria.explanation: The promise is documented in the Bronx-project materials: 47% of employees will be women. The excerpts do not show actual hiring at Bally’s Bronx. Chicago performance is only contextual support for the promise and cannot be transferred as delivery for the Bronx workforce.
criteria.gap: No direct evidence establishes an actual women share among Bally’s Bronx employees, and the project is not yet shown to be operational.

criteria.criterion: Bally’s said 75% of employees for Bally’s Bronx would be minorities.
criteria.promise_scope: Promisor: Bally’s (as applicant). Intended beneficiaries/covered group: employees of the proposed Bally’s Bronx permanent operations. Location: the Bronx, New York. Benefit/action: Bally’s states that 75% of employees will be minorities / that the workforce will reflect Bronx demographics.
criteria.observed_scope: Observed evidence documents the proposed Bronx target and provides Chicago context: over 80% of employees at Bally’s Chicago temporary facility identify as minority. That Chicago figure is not evidence of actual minority share in the Bronx workforce. No actual Bally’s Bronx workforce composition is reported.
criteria.timing_requirement: For permanent operations of the proposed Bally’s Bronx project; the project is "projected to open by mid- 2030."
criteria.explanation: The Bronx commitment/target is documented. But the delivered outcome asked here would be the actual minority share of Bally’s Bronx employees, and the cited record does not show that workforce exists yet. Chicago minority-share evidence is for another facility and serves only as context for Bally’s expectations.
criteria.gap: No direct evidence shows the actual minority share of employees at Bally’s Bronx; the project is still prospective as of the as-of date.

criteria.criterion: Whether Bally’s Bronx has actually hired a workforce meeting the stated Bronx-resident, women, and minority shares.
criteria.promise_scope: Promisor: Bally’s (as applicant). Intended beneficiaries/covered group: the future permanent-operation workforce at Bally’s Bronx. Location: the Bronx, New York. Benefit/action: actual workforce composition meeting the stated shares: 70% Bronx residents, 47% women, 75% minorities.
criteria.observed_scope: The observed record shows only a proposed project in the Bronx with stated future workforce targets, plus Chicago workforce composition at a temporary facility. It also states Bally’s Bronx is not yet operational and is projected to open by mid-2030. No actual Bronx workforce hiring outcome is shown.
criteria.timing_requirement: Outcome would be assessable once Bally’s Bronx permanent operations exist; cited material says the project is projected to open by mid-2030 and not operational during the first three and one-half years of the projection period.
criteria.explanation: The requested query can be read as asking both what Bally’s stated and whether that composition has actually been achieved. The excerpts establish the stated targets, but not actual hiring in the Bronx. Because the project is still projected to open in the future, the actual-delivery question is not yet due on the cited timeline.
criteria.gap: No direct evidence of an operating Bally’s Bronx workforce or of realized demographic shares among its employees.
